Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
很久以前，古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃。所以很多人常常吃不安全的植物，吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况。但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the harmful plants are mentioned, add a physical result to show the danger, for example: “很多人吃了有毒的植物以后，肚子疼得厉害。”
2. When introducing 神农, add his purpose or feeling to make him more vivid, for example: “神农看到大家常常生病，心里很着急。”

ideas.reason: It gives a concrete, story-appropriate effect of eating poisonous plants in simple Chinese.
It adds a fitting motivation for Shennong without changing the traditional story.
